title: verdict.v1
description: The `verdict.json` of a run directory: every window with its impact against its budget, the impact outside every window, and the integrity of the measurement. `hakit verdict <run-dir>` recomputes it from the run directory alone. ADR-0049.

status.description: `invalid` when an integrity finding exists (the run measured nothing trustworthy); else `fail` when any impact is a finding; else `pass`.

streams.description: Per stream: calls placed, records read, successes.

calls.description: Calls the generator says it placed (its own counter); null when the generator keeps none.

event.description: The event id: its sequence number and incident names.

phases.description: The instant of each phase the event reached, by phase name.

facts.description: The JSON objects the incident executables printed, by executable (`inject`, `heal`, `probe`).

recovery_s.description: Seconds from `healed` until traffic was back to its baseline; null when it never was before the window closed.

findings.description: The number of impacts above their allowance in this window.

unattributed.description: Impact outside every window, by class and key. Every entry is a finding.

integrity.description: Why the measurement itself is in doubt.

kind.description: `record_gap`: a stream's records differ from its generator's call counter. `incident_failed`: an executable failed or timed out. `stream_died`: a generator exited before the load ended. `series_stale`: a series the run reads stopped updating. `generator_failure`: a record names a `generator` failure. `leftover_calls`: the system under test held calls before the run started.

class.description: A built-in impact class or one a product added on the search path.

count.description: Calls (or events, for a class counted in events); for `recovery`, seconds.

seconds.description: The count in seconds of the stream's offered rate, when the impact has a stream.

allowed.description: The allowance the budget gives this key, in the unit of `count`.

call_ids.description: The Call-IDs of the calls counted, up to 50.
